transcript.text: Section 1.
You will hear a telephone conversation between a woman who is looking for information about
holidays and an agent for a tour company.
First, you have some time to look at questions 1-7 on page 2.
You will see that there is an example that has been done for you.
done for you.
On this occasion only, the conversation relating to this will be played first.
Agent: Asia-Pacific Tours, can I help you?
Customer: Yes, I've been looking at your website and I'd like some more information about your activity
holidays.
Agent: Certainly.
Agent: You know of course the prices of the tours include stays in three star hotels and they include
airfares.
Customer: Great.
Customer: What about your tour of Vietnam?
Customer: My sister went there last year and loved it.
Your English?
The first tour the caller asks about is Vietnam.
So Vietnam has been written in the space.
Now we shall begin.
You should answer the questions as you listen because you will not hear the recording
a second time.
Listen carefully and answer questions 1-7.
Agent: Asia-Pacific Tours, can I help you?
Customer: Yes, I've been looking at your website and I'd like some more information about your
activity holidays.
Agent: Certainly.
Agent: You know of course the prices of the tours include stays in three star hotels and they include
airfares.
Customer: Great.
Customer: What about your tour of Vietnam?
Customer: My sister went there last year and loved it.
Agent: Yes, it's a really beautiful place and probably our fastest growing destination.
Agent: Now that package includes several opportunities to take courses.
Customer: Don't you have a cookery course of some kind?
Agent: We certainly do.
Agent: If you love eating out in Vietnam like most people do and want to know how to prepare a meal,
you can learn how from a master in a five star hotel.
Agent: On another day you have a choice of two activities.
Agent: The first is instruction in diving in the South China Sea.
Agent: Not a certificate course but just an introduction.
Agent: Most people think it's wonderful.
Agent: Or if you want to stay dry but still want some exercise, you can spend the day on a trek
through the jungle near the beach.
Agent: It's not difficult and everyone seems to enjoy it.
Customer: Anything cultural on offer?
Agent: We used to take people to a Vietnamese opera but that didn't prove so popular.
Agent: So now we include a dance show and our clients all rave about that.
Agent: They say the colours are just magnificent.
Customer: Hmm, what's the cost?
Agent: I've just noticed it's now a special price.
Agent: The holiday used to be £1,600 but it's just been reduced to £1,450 so you do save quite
a bit and as I said it seems to be our up and coming tour.
Customer: Well, let's see, perhaps you could tell me a little about the Hong Kong tour.
Customer: I noticed it includes a walk in the hills of one of their country parks where you have
the chance to see birds of all sorts.
Agent: Yes, that's a very popular activity.
Agent: People don't realise that Hong Kong isn't just a crowded city.
Agent: That's a half day activity and you go with a trained escort and it includes dinner in
a monastery where you end your day.
Agent: And then we wouldn't want you to miss out all together on shopping so there's another
day when we take you around an electronics factory.
Agent: Now that might sound like an odd thing to do but it's actually really fascinating and
not like your usual ceramics factory and you can buy their products there quite cheaply.
Agent: Now the whole Hong Kong package is just £1,320 per person.
Customer: Sounds interesting.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation you have some time to look at questions 8
to 10 on page 2.
You all listen?
Now listen and answer questions 8 to 10.
Customer: But let me find out about one more place.
Customer: I've always wanted to go to Korea but not on this trip.
Customer: And I've been to Thailand which I loved but what about your Japan package?
Agent: Good choice.
Agent: Well that tour includes a terrific trip to a museum of traditional costume.
Agent: The exhibits are gorgeous.
Agent: They've got an absolutely priceless collection.
Customer: And I think the website says you take your clients to a market don't you?
Customer: A crafts market I think.
Agent: Well we do go to a market but it's one that sells fish and it's one of the largest in the world.
Agent: And you have the chance to sample the wares in a little restaurant nearby.
Agent: We also give you plenty of free time to wander around the city with our guides if you want.
Customer: And what's the cost of all that?
Customer: Well you've been ever so helpful.
Customer: I've noted all the details down and I'll get back to you when I've made up my mind.
Agent: If we can give you any more help, do ring back.
Customer: Thanks, I will.
Joel Inglitz Joel Inglitz
That is the end of section one.
